description: Gets one marketplace health plan by its 14-character plan ID and plan year. Returns the metal level, plan type, insurer, deductibles and out-of-pocket maximums as the CMS file states them, the drug list counts by tier with prior approval, step therapy and quantity limit counts, the size of the insurer's directory for the plan, and links to the plan documents. The amounts are not a quote for you.

plan_id.description: The 14-character plan ID from the plan documents, such as 31274WV0560001.

year.description: The plan year, such as 2027. The default is the latest year OpenHealth reads.

name: get_health_plan
title: Get a marketplace health plan
